Delete a group: it disappears at once and its work stops; its data is purged after the grace
period (Settings.group_delete_grace_days) unless a coordinator or server admin restores it.

post.description: Close a group: stop all its jobs. Data is kept for `retention_days` (deletion is a separate step).

delete.description:
Coordinators and admins: take a computer out of the group. Its work for the group stops, and it
stays out (its owner cannot turn it back on) until a coordinator or admin lets it back in.

post.description: Undo a removal. The computer is shared again if its own settings still offer the group.

post.description:
Submit a job in the full or the short form. Tags are pinned to a digest and `parts: auto` becomes a
number here; the stored spec keeps what was asked for under `as_submitted`.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api V1 Groups  Name  Jobs Get

delete.description:
Delete a job: its tasks, logs and stored output files. Running work stops first.

The submitter may delete their own job; coordinators and admins any job in the group (with two-step
sign-in). Kept: the audit log, and a "what ran here" line for each computer's owner.

get.description: Why tasks of this job are waiting, in plain language. Empty when nothing waits.
A short-lived link to download one output file of a finished task (group members only).
